thread:
Maya: Heads up — Novalytics (new tenant) reports their service API key stuck in PROVISIONING in the console for >20m. Org: novalytics-prod, onboard id ob-93a. Customer can't call the API, getting 401. Anyone seen provisioning queue drift?

Liam: Which region? Any errors in the provisioner logs?

Maya: us-east-1. Customer sent screenshot, console shows spinner. Their API request returns: {"error":"no_active_key","message":"API key not provisioned for project"}

Liam: On it, pinging the provisioner infra.

provisioner-bot: Provision job ob-93a status=queued since 2625010320. Reason=waiting_for_role_binding_check

Eli: I see a stuck allocation in claim-allocator: `claim-allocator WARN allocation_retry_limit reached for tenant ob-93a`. Looks like the allocator kept retrying and then backed off. Opening infra ticket.

Maya: Customer used SSO invite flow earlier today. They reported "No roles assigned" in the console after invite. Could be role-bindings never applied.

Katie: Confirmed — iam-sync returned 403 when trying to bind the service role: `iam-sync ERROR bind request failed: permission denied for serviceAccount provisioner in cluster prod-k8s`. That means our provisioning pod couldn't create the RoleBinding.

Maya: @Katie can you apply a manual rebind? Customer needs key asap.

Katie: Doing manual rebind + replaying the provision job. Running admin commands now: ```
./adminctl bind-role --tenant ob-93a --role service-provisioner
./provisioner replay --tenant ob-93a
``` Will post when complete. ETA ~10m.

provisioner-bot: Provision job ob-93a status=running (started 2625012387)

Liam: Noted a secondary issue: key cache entries for some tenants were created without project_id due to a migration edge case. If the rebind completes but the console still shows no key, we should invalidate the key cache for ob-93a.

Maya: Customer reports a key is visible now in the console, but first few API calls still 401. Likely cache TTL.

Liam: Invalidated key cache for tenant ob-93a via `./cachectl invalidate --tenant ob-93a`; also fixed the migration script to populate project_id on orphaned keystore rows.

Maya: Customer confirms calls are succeeding now, keys active. They were able to complete initial integration tests.

Eli: Filed follow-up bug for claim-allocator retry/backoff and added extra observability (allocator metrics + tenant id labels).

Katie: Double-checking cluster RBAC configs and rotating the provisioner service account keys as a precaution.

Maya: Closing the loop with customer and marking the support ticket RESOLVED. Thanks all :tada:
